summary: ContentPackRegistry autoload: scans user://packs/ and res://packs/ for .pck files and for plain pack directories, reads C8's pack.json, merges overrides by scene ID in load order, and answers presentation_level_for / override_for / loaded_packs against the one fade_to_black < explicit level table.

coordination.notes: The manifest schema has exactly one owner: tools/src/validate.mjs's packFile block (C8). This registry is the runtime reader, not a second validator -- it refuses only what it cannot use and says why. The fixture pack at packs/pack.presentation.fixture/ is NOT copied under game/; scan(root) takes an explicit root so the suite points it at the repository directory by absolute path. game/project.godot takes one appended [autoload] line at the end of the block, so parallel lanes merge as keep-both tails. content/relationships records already reach Godot through the bundle as scene.<woman>.<slug> records, so ContentCatalog.has/get_record answer the base presentationLevel and the catalog needed no new accessor at all. Nothing in the Rust crate or the port is touched: the simulation never reads presentation.

checks: Godot 4.7.2-stable (the exact pinned CI engine, SHA-512 verified) run locally: game/tests/pack_registry_test.gd, EXIT=0, printing only 'ContentPackRegistry pack tests passed.' and no ERROR, SCRIPT ERROR or backtrace line: passed

CI Verify run 34018590172 on ddfdd55, both jobs green -- 'Rust and content' and 'Godot headless suites', the latter ending 'Real Rust bridge confirmed: all three native suites reported a pass.' with the gate's fallback-marker scan clean; verify-godot.sh globs game/tests/*_test.gd, so the new suite ran inside that gate: passed

Done-when, with the pack: presentation_level_for('scene.betty.the_lamp_left_burning') reads the fixture pack's targetLevel fade_to_black, and override_for resolves the fixture's two declared assets, one per overridden scene, to files that exist inside packs/pack.presentation.fixture/assets/: passed
Done-when, without: a registry that scanned nothing returns the scene's authored presentationLevel from the content bundle and an empty override_for: passed
A scene the fixture does not override (scene.betty.the_second_watch) falls back to base with no override: passed
A pack.json whose declared asset is not a file inside the pack is refused whole, the reason names the path, loaded_packs stays empty and none of its overrides merge: passed

The level switch proved for real: a second pack written by the suite under user:// with targetLevel explicit lifts presentation_level_for to explicit, wins the scene it shares with the fixture (later wins, and the winning pack ID is recorded), leaves the fixture's other scene at fade_to_black, and lifts nothing for a scene no pack overrides: passed
